How to Download Rajasthan BSTC Result 2026?

Rajasthan BSTC Result 2026 can be checked online through the official website. Candidates need to log in using basic details like roll number and name. The result can be downloaded from the result link. Follow the steps below.

  1. Visit the official website @predeledraj2026.in
  2. Click on Rajasthan BSTC 2026 Result link
  3. Enter roll number, name and mother’s name
  4. Click on submit button
  5. Result will appear on the screen
  6. Download and take a printout for future use

Details mentioned in Rajasthan BSTC Pre D.El.Ed Result 2026

Rajasthan BSTC Result 2026 includes important details related to candidate and exam performance. Candidates should check all information on the scorecard after downloading it. The details are important for the counselling and admission process. The details mentioned in the result are as follows.
